title: Carter's 1976 UFO briefing by CIA director George H.W. Bush

tellings.quote: 76 you know the first thing he did was he sent for the head of the Central Intelligence Agency to come down to Plains Georgia to brief him on the UFO issue and it turns out that person was George H W bush
I think Carter wanted him to brief him on UFOs, but he then he wanted to be, you know, um made director of the CIA
tellings.difference: The host tells it without crediting Sheehan, does not name Plains, Georgia, and is unsure about the order of events in Bush's career.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Carter, as president-elect, wanted CIA director George H.W. Bush to brief him on UFOs in 1976.

as_told.title: Carter wanted CIA director Bush to brief him on UFOs

plain: After Jimmy Carter won the 1976 election, the first thing he did, the story goes, was send for the head of the CIA to come to Plains, Georgia, and brief him on UFOs, and that person turned out to be George H. W. Bush. Michels tells it on the show, crediting a man named Dan Sheehan. On a later show he tells it again without naming Sheehan or Plains, and sounds less sure of the order of events in Bush's career, which would matter because it suggests a new president thought the CIA knew something about UFOs.
